# Three.js 0.186.1

Unmodified files from the official npm package `three@0.186.1` (MIT license).
`three.module.js`, `three.core.js`, and `examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js` are
included locally so the isolated 3D preview does not depend on a CDN.

Source: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r186
Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/three/v/0.186.1
The original license is included in `LICENSE`. The 2D game does not import these files.
